paragraphs: R. Yoshiyah of Usha spoke to Rabbah bar bar Chana: Menachot 39a, in Shmuel's name, as in the new Talmud editions there. Rabbah bar bar Chana said, “R. Yoshiyah of Usha told me”—Bekhorot 28b; Elu Mumin, 38b, beginning. Rabbah bar bar Chana said, “Five elders were we before him”—Gittin 33b.
